newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to destroy violent Modelo prison.
newsitem.headline: Panama to destroy violent Modelo prison.

text.p: Panamanian authorities plan to destroy the notoriously violent Modelo prison where guards have been filmed beating naked convicts with sticks, an Interior Ministry spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

"We plan to have all prisoners moved from Modelo by Friday or Saturday," the spokeswoman said. "The prison will be closed but we will allow tours for those who want to see it before it is destroyed Dec. 10," she said.
The prisoners will be transferred to two recently-opened prisons in the Panama City area, she added.

Modelo, which has a capacity of 275 prisoners but has held upto 3,000, became a centre of controversy in July when local television showed guards herding naked prisoners into an outdoor courtyard and beating them.
The guards were quelling a riot in which two prisoners were killed and nearly a dozen prisoners and guards were wounded.
President Ernesto Perez Balladares will attend a public ceremony on Dec. 10 for the destruction of Modelo by dynamite, the spokeswoman said.
